title: Ship the operator-questions skill
description: Add skills/operator-questions/SKILL.md and its supporting files, per the design in opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-skill-design.md at opum-doc origin/main 1312f0c, section Changes this needs in plain-english-styles item 1. The skill shapes one A/B/C operator question sized to the active Plain English level, and files and records it in Quest and Lore. Shape and level table first; SKILL.md under 500 lines; supporting files levels.md, diagrams.md and quest-and-lore.md; description and when_to_use under 1536 characters together.

acceptanceCriteria.text: skills/operator-questions/SKILL.md exists and is under 500 lines
